| 场景 | 是否适合 `std::function` | 原因 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 函数里立刻调用一次回调 | 不一定 | 模板参数通常更轻量 |
| 类成员变量保存一个回调 | 适合 | 成员变量需要稳定类型 |
| `vector` 保存多个不同 lambda | 适合 | 容器元素必须是同一种类型 |
| 高频性能热点里的小函数 | 谨慎 | `std::function` 有类型擦除开销 |
| 只保存无捕获函数 | 函数指针也可以 | 但函数指针不能保存有捕获 lambda |
fa6d0a4de0fe87e19725f168d3d2c3e8a3b85171.translatedText:
| Scenario | Is it suitable?`std::function` | Reason |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Calling a callback once immediately inside a function | Not necessarily | Template parameters are usually more lightweight |
| Storing a callback in a class member variable | Suitable | Member variables need a stable type |
| `vector`Storing multiple different lambdas | Suitable | Container elements must all be of the same type |
| A small function in a high\-frequency performance hotspot | Be cautious | `std::function`There is type erasure overhead |
| Storing only captureless functions | A function pointer also works | But a function pointer cannot store a capturing lambda |

faab6fbfa84cba3eeb6c2402972c06ee9002d09d.sourceText:
1. 需要保存回调时，用 `std::function`。
2. 需要统一不同类型的回调时，用 `std::function`。
3. 只是立刻调用一次回调时，可以优先考虑模板参数。
4. 保存回调时特别注意捕获对象的生命周期。
5. 不要把 `std::function` 当成所有回调场景的唯一答案，它是清晰性和灵活性的工具，也有一定运行期开销。
faab6fbfa84cba3eeb6c2402972c06ee9002d09d.translatedText:
1. When you need to store a callback, use `std::function`\.
2. When you need to unify callbacks of different types, use `std::function`\.
3. When you only need to invoke a callback once immediately, prefer a template parameter\.
4. When storing callbacks, pay special attention to the lifetime of captured objects\.
5. Do not treat `std::function` as the sole answer for all callback scenarios; it is a tool for clarity and flexibility, and it also has a certain runtime overhead\.

fad5f1c9cf4f61086551509eea4b0a3b918f1aad.sourceText:
| 需求 | 推荐工具 |
|---|---|
| 最多允许 N 个线程同时获得资源 | `std::counting_semaphore` |
| 一个简单的 0 / 1 许可或线程间信号 | `std::binary_semaphore` |
| 等 N 个参与者一次性全部完成 | `std::latch` |
| 多个线程每轮都要同步 | `std::barrier` |
| 保护共享对象一致性 | `std::mutex` |
| 等复杂共享条件成立 | `std::condition_variable` |
fad5f1c9cf4f61086551509eea4b0a3b918f1aad.translatedText:
| Requirement | Recommended Tool |
|---|---|
| At most N threads are allowed to acquire the resource simultaneously | `std::counting_semaphore` |
| A simple 0/1 permit or inter\-thread signal | `std::binary_semaphore` |
| Wait for N participants to all complete at once | `std::latch` |
| Multiple threads must synchronize each round | `std::barrier` |
| Protect consistency of shared objects | `std::mutex` |
| Wait for complex shared conditions to hold | `std::condition_variable` |
